wrong.name: template literal text ignored
wrong.scenario: A comment marker inside template literal text is not a comment
wrong.step: Then rank-javascript-template-string-comment-markers: the matches are on lines "2, 1" in that order

src/rank.rs.patch:
diff --git a/src/rank.rs b/src/rank.rs
index 298eebb..ce51c16 100644
--- a/src/rank.rs
+++ b/src/rank.rs
@@ -139,7 +139,7 @@ fn line_kind(extension: &str, line: &str, at: usize, literal_len: usize) -> Line
                     marker,
                     extension == "php",
                     extension == "rs",
-                    JAVASCRIPT_EXTENSIONS.contains(&extension),

                 )))

         return LineKind::Comment;

wrong.name: line with template literal loses its comment
wrong.scenario: A comment after a closed template literal is still a comment
wrong.step: Then rank-javascript-template-string-comment-markers: the matches are on lines "2, 1" in that order

wrong.name: template literals in other languages
wrong.scenario: Other languages do not get template literal handling
wrong.step: Then rank-javascript-template-string-comment-markers: the matches are on lines "1, 2" in that order
